patch_description: This crossover retains the stronger RY–CZ–RZ structure of the current candidate while borrowing the inspiration program’s closed-ring connectivity. A shared pre-rotation phase layer adds useful expressivity with only four additional parameters per repetition, pairing opposite qubits to regularize the model. The closing CZ edge connects qubits 7 and 0 without introducing the poorer-performing full CNOT network. This targets higher validation accuracy and lower loss while remaining substantially more parameter-efficient than the 146-parameter reference.
